overview.description: The Anthropic AI Lab Ecosystem ETF (ANTW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests primarily in companies the fund adviser believes are closely linked to the Anthropic artificial intelligence ecosystem. The fund seeks to provide exposure to portfolio-eligible companies most directly linked to the Anthropic AI ecosystem. ANTW was launched on Aug 12, 2026 and is issued by Harbor.
